ECG+ integrates with Apple Health to unleash the greatest power of your Apple Watch ECG, by analyzing and calculating heart rate variability (HRV) out of your ECG data, which is widely considered one of the best objective metrics for physical fitness and determining your body’s readiness to perform. Additionally, ECG+ app also provides detailed analysis of heartbeat intervals, including QT/QTc, which is an important indicator of your heart's electrical activity.

HRV refers to the variation in time between successive heartbeats, which is an indicator of the health of the autonomic nervous system. QT interval refers to the time it takes for the heart to recharge between beats, which is important for assessing cardiac health.

With HRV trends you can learn your health level changes. A up hill trend means a better physical fitness level and a down hill indicates you should pay more attention to your overall health. With QT trends you can monitor closely your QT intervals over a period of time and seek healthcare attention whenever a prolonged QT is identified automatically.

2. Calculate HRV (using RMSSD)
3. View Poincaré plot / R-R interval plot
4. HRV trends
5. Generate PDF report with HRV info
6. Send your ECG report to your healthcare provider

So what is HRV?
HRV is a measure of your autonomic nervous system that is widely considered one of the best objective metrics for physical fitness and determining your body’s readiness to perform.

Although HRV manifests as a function of your heart rate, it actually originates from your nervous system. Your autonomic nervous system, which controls the involuntary aspects of your physiology, has two branches, parasympathetic (deactivating) and sympathetic (activating).

The parasympathetic branch (often referred to as “rest and digest”) handles inputs from internal organs, like digestion or your fingernails and hair growing. It causes a decrease in heart rate. The sympathetic branch (often called “fight or flight”) reflects responses to things like stress and exercise, and increases your heart rate.

Heart rate variability comes from these two competing branches simultaneously sending signals to your heart. If your nervous system is balanced, your heart is constantly being told to beat slower by your parasympathetic system, and beat faster by your sympathetic system. This causes a fluctuation in your heart rate: HRV.

Learn:  10 respiratory medicine assessments in a guided assessment style (at bedside/in clinic).  These include associated patient histories, auscultation sounds and chest x-rays.

Important information:  The audio quality of the sounds played through a computer, tablet or smartphone device may not be a faithful representation of the actual sounds heard on auscultation.  This is due to the acoustical performance of sound cards, their associated drivers, or the frequency response of the headphones or speakers used.  Therefore there is a possibility that the user may not be able to fully hear all clinically relevant sounds.  We recommend the use of a high quality pair of headphones.

Esta aplicación móvil desarrollada por la Sociedad Argentina de Pediatría nos permite mejorar la evaluación del crecimiento de todos los niños, niñas y adolescentes.
Esta herramienta supera a otras existentes porque utiliza nuestras curvas y nos permite un diagnóstico auxológico validado por SAP. Es un complemento de las Guías de Evaluación del Crecimiento y refuerzan el hecho de la necesidad del uso de técnicas e instrumental adecuado para arribar a un correcto diagnóstico auxológico.
Incluye:
-Referencias Argentinas: Permite la evaluación del peso, estatura, estatura sentada calculando los centilos, puntaje z y la gráfica. Son de utilidad para el seguimiento clínico y para el diagnóstico de alta y baja estatura. También permite valorar las proporciones corporales con el cálculo de los índices estatura sentada / estatura y perímetro cefálico/estatura.
- Estándares OMS:  Permite la evaluación del peso, estatura, perímetro cefálico e índice de masa corporal calculando los centilos, puntaje z y la gráfica. Son de utilidad para el seguimiento y para la valoración del estado nutricional ya que permiten evaluar el índice de masa corporal.
- Estándares Intergrowth: Permite la evaluación del crecimiento postnatal del peso, estatura, y perímetro cefálico de recién nacidos/as prematuros, ingresando la fecha de nacimiento y la edad gestacional. Corrige la edad actual según la edad gestacional. Calcula el puntaje z y gráfica.
-Referencias para acondroplasia:  permite la evaluación del peso, estatura, perímetro cefálico e índice de masa corporal calculando los centilos, puntaje z y la gráfica.
-Referencias Síndrome de Down: permite la evaluación del peso, estatura, perímetro cefálico graficando el dato ingresado.
-Referencias de perímetro cefálico de Nelhauss permite la evaluación del tamaño del perímetro cefálico graficándolo al ingresar el dato.
-Referencias de Síndrome de Turner: permite la graficaciòn del tamaño en estatura de niñas con Síndrome de turner al ingresar el dato
